description: Records the outcome of a campaign call step (answered or no_answer), as the Growth queue's call buttons do, so the sequence can move on. It records the outcome only: it places no call and sends nothing. taskId is the call step's task, from the send queue. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying; a replay reports the state already on record.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: record_campaign_call_outcome
title: Record a campaign call outcome
